verdict.rationale: Runpod's network volumes expose an S3-compatible API and runpodctl CLI for transferring files off the platform, and Pods run standard Docker images (portable elsewhere), which supports leaving without total lock-in. However there's no explicit documentation of a full account/data export feature, no mention of exporting job/template configs or serverless endpoint definitions in an open format, and no independent evidence of a full migrate-and-leave workflow. Missing for 10: explicit full-account export tooling, documented config/template export in open formats, independent confirmation of smooth migration off-platform.
